mutants.name: a_id_only_skill_row
mutants.description: Match a SKILL row by id alone, omitting the remaining row requirements.
mutants.before:
r.startswith(f"| {rid} |") and sig in r and isinstance(row, str)
                and re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(row)}\b", r) and len(cells) >= 5
                and all(cells) and isinstance(req0.get("path"), str)
                and any(req0["path"] in c for c in cells)
                and len(cells[-2].split()) >= 6

mutants.name: a_no_path_cell
mutants.before: any(req0["path"] in c for c in cells)

mutants.name: b_no_signature_shape_or_novelty
mutants.description: Discard signature-shape and held-at-base rejections at the static-check return.
mutants.after: [w for w in why if not w.startswith("b:")]

mutants.name: c_no_sources_row_validation
mutants.description: Skip new SOURCES row and citation metadata validation.
mutants.before:
srow is None or row in src_base or not isinstance(fname, str)
            or fname not in srow or COMMIT not in srow or not isinstance(line, int)
            or not re.search(rf"(#L{line}\b|\bL{line}\b|line {line}\b)", srow)

mutants.name: d_no_literal_binding
mutants.description: Skip signature substring binding to cited C literals.
mutants.before: not any(sig in t for t in literal_texts(lines[line - 1]))

mutants.name: d_error_token_window_to_file_start
mutants.description: Weaken the four-line ERROR_TOKENS window to all preceding lines.

mutants.name: e_no_live_error_acceptance
mutants.description: Skip bad status, missing JSON error message, and signature-not-shown rejection.
mutants.before: qs < 400 or msg is None or e["signature"] not in msg

mutants.name: f_literal_case_sensitive_occurs
mutants.description: Weaken case/whitespace-folded surface scanning to exact literal matching.
mutants.before: sig.lower() in text.lower() or squash(sig) in squash(text)

mutants.name: f_no_request_surface_echo_check
mutants.before: any(occurs(sig, s) for s in request_surfaces(req))

mutants.name: f_no_baseline_or_help_check
mutants.description: Skip healthy baseline, log, help and version overlap rejection.
mutants.before: isinstance(sig, str) and sig and occurs(sig, baseline)

mutants.name: g_no_control_result_check
mutants.description: Skip both control status and control signature-absence rejection.

mutants.name: g_no_control_status_check
mutants.description: Skip only the successful control-status requirement, retaining the signature-absence check.

mutants.name: h_no_uniqueness_checks
mutants.description: Do not compare the candidate with earlier counted rows.

mutants.name: h_no_same_next_action_check
mutants.description: Skip only the folded same-next-action comparison.
